question: Does disabling the expert answer-only adapter change terminal answers with identical full task/history and matched sampling?
inputs: 12 different fresh development task/source groups: six original private terminal failures and six original stable correct controls; deterministic hash selection within predeclared strata, no new holdout
manipulation: Only backend adapter on/off; M1 model-visible identity, full paragraphs, own history, system/user prompt, output cap and within-pair seed identical
primary: Paired final EM changes on/off, separately for failures and stable controls; raw text/semantic target switch and original-seed reproduction also audited
limits: Outcome-selected fixed prefixes, one Qwen4B/SFT/quantization/configuration, 12 groups and 2 seeds; no prevalence, team benefit, generic expert deficit or psychological mechanism claim

predictions.off_recovers_failures_controls_retained: Supports local adapter contribution to terminal mismatch, not its universal cause
predictions.both_fail: Adapter alone insufficient; inspect shared finalization prompt/history and target specificity
predictions.off_harms_controls: Report loss as well as recovery; no blanket adapter-off policy
predictions.on_original_seed_does_not_reproduce: Audit actual payload/model/template/runtime before treating original failure selection as replicated

authorization: User latest 开始吧 follows proposed ordinary comparison and minimal diagnostic; within existing local lab-compute scope, no paid API
